extracted.name: Spicy sardine dip
extracted.description: You can easily transform a tin of sardines into a spicy dip. This is a handy recipe, perfect for any impromptu gatherings
ingredient_lines: 125g can sardines in chilli olive oil
100g crème fraîche yogurt or soured cream
small handful of parsley finely chopped
instruction_lines: Drain the sardines and tip the sardines into a bowl, reserving the oil. Remove the backbones if there are any, and discard. Lightly mash the sardines using a fork. Mix in the crème fraîche, yogurt or soured cream, the lemon zest and a splash of the juice, the shallot, parsley and smoked paprika, cayenne pepper and onion granules. Season well and add more lemon juice, if needed. Drizzle over the reserved oil to serve.
